svg.title: Tangent Vector Field V4
svg.desc: Computed rotational tangent vector field X=(-y,x,0) on the unit sphere, with arrows generated from sampled tangent vectors.

g.text: A vector field must live in the correct tangent space.
Sphere field X(p)=k×p=(-y,x,0); every rendered arrow is tested for tangency X·p=0.
Arrow direction and length are computed from a normalized tangent field; the grid is source geometry.
